target_distinctions.electrical_demand_vs_generation: Renewable PV/Wind generation does NOT equal station electrical load.
target_distinctions.electrical_demand_vs_meteorology: Solar irradiance (SW_IN) and wind speed (v_wind) are weather drivers, NOT electrical demand.
